zoe: Hey all, quick onboarding Q: how do I safely get staging secrets (DB + stripe test key) for my first PR without creating permanent creds?

rachel (devex): welcome Zoe! :wave: Use the internal portal -> Secrets Access. For local work we prefer dynamic DB creds or short-lived KV tokens. In your request include repo/PR and TTL.

zoe: Any small template I can paste into the form?

rachel (devex): Yep - paste this:
- resources: secret/team/staging/stripe, database/staging-postgres
- reason: local testing for PR #57
- principal: zoe (user) and svc-account=svc-ci-staging
- duration: 8h (or 2h for DB dynamic)

omar (sec): Rotation basics: dynamic DB leases expire automatically (typical TTL 1h). KV secrets: default rotation policy is 90d for vendor API keys, 30d for our internal tokens. Add `ticket=` metadata when you write new versions.

rachel (devex): Quick CLI flow: `vault login -method=oidc role=redwood-dev` then `vault read database/creds/staging-app` or `VAULT_ADDR=https://vault.internal vault kv get -field=api_key secret/team/staging/stripe`. Use `vault agent` for auto-renew in local runs.

infra-bot: [audit] secrets.request created id=req-6109 by zoe (status=pending)

zoe: Thanks — submitting now. Will ping if approval stalls.

omar (sec): Ping me for a quick pairing on rotation verification after you get the creds.
